description: Triggers for setting up, adopting or auditing repository agent instructions and the sdlc-dod Definition of Done, vendoring gate scripts, keeping the adoption ledger, defining CONSTRAINTS.md, building a glossary, preparing CI enforcement inputs, or recording an agent mistake

queries.query: Set up an AGENTS.md for this repository so coding agents know how to build and test it
Our CLAUDE.md is 400 lines and stale — clean it up without losing important rules
Agents keep adding ts-ignore to get green builds. Write a quality bar they can't weaken
Create a CONSTRAINTS.md with coverage and security thresholds for this project
Record this: the agent ran pytest outside the virtualenv again, don't let it happen next time
Build a glossary — 'account' means three different things in this codebase
Audit our agent instructions: are the commands in AGENTS.md still correct?
Prepare the project context before we start the Agentic SDLC on this repo
Write the README for end users explaining how to install the app
Write an ADR for choosing Postgres over MongoDB
Review this diff for code quality
Brainstorm features for our next release
Show me all installed skills and MCP servers on this machine
Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that deploys to staging
preflight says there is no sdlc-dod block in AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md — fix the Definition of Done for our Go service
We already use Kiro steering files and a Spec Kit constitution; adopt the Agentic SDLC without duplicating them
The checksum check on .agentic-sdlc/bin fails after upgrading the skills — re-vendor the scripts
Which values do the agentic-sdlc CI templates need from our repo, and can we mark enforcement as branch-protection yet?
Configure branch protection rules and required reviewers on GitHub for the main branch
Run the retrospective for last sprint and pick improvement actions
The agent mocked the repository layer again for the third cycle in a row; turn it into an owned retro action with an automated check
